hitos.explicacion: Steps you reach only once. Each milestone brings the goal closer to its destination.
hitos.sinHitosAnillo: The goal has no milestones yet to measure its progress
hitos.desmarcar: "{{nombre}}" is reached. Tap to set it back to pending
hitos.vacioCreador: Add milestones to know how far you have left: for example, each book finished or each million saved.
hitos.vacioInvitado: This goal has no milestones yet.
hitos.habitosExplicacion: What you repeat on certain days. They measure how consistent you are.
hitos.habitosVacioCreador: Add habits for every day: for example, read 15 pages or save money every Monday.
hitos.habitosVacioInvitado: This goal has no habits yet.
hitos.llegasteTexto: You made it to the destination of "{{meta}}". Mark it as achieved to celebrate, earn your badges and share it.
hitos.tarjetaSinCaminoCreador: This goal doesn't have a path yet. Add milestones to know how far you have left and habits for every day.
hitos.tarjetaSinCaminoInvitado: The goal's creator hasn't laid out the path yet. Once they add steps, you'll track your progress here.
hitos.eliminarMetaPasos_one: step of the path (milestone or habit)
hitos.eliminarMetaPasos_other: steps of the path (milestones and habits)
hitos.verHistorial: Tap to see the history by day, week or month

subMetaPaso.hitoTexto: A step you reach only once. It tells you how far you have left. E.g.: Finish book 3, Open the savings account.
subMetaPaso.resumenHito: When you reach it, mark it in Your path: the goal's progress will go up.
subMetaPaso.ideasTexto: Tap one to start with it; you can rename it afterwards.
subMetaPaso.grupoHito: To measure how far you have left
